messages:
Ava: Quick design review: preflight summary UI for private setup. Sharing mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Wanted to get copy + accessibility nits before I sync with Eng.
Sam: :eyes: Looking. Can we collapse pass/fail counts? The list is overwhelming.
Ava: Plan: top-level status summary (green/red), then grouped actionable items with `Show steps` toggles. Need copy suggestions for failure states.
Ravi: Implementation note: preflight runs inside customer's VPC. We only surface connectivity hints, not scan internals. For port guidance, can we link to KB? Also prefer concise copy for side panel to avoid scrolling on small screens.
Jess: Proposed copy for failure banner: 'Network check found issues — your cluster may not be reachable. Click Learn how to fix or run the verifier again.' Thoughts?
Maya: A11y: screen reader should get an aria-live="polite" update when the scan finishes and a focus trap to the summary. Also color contrast on the red failure badge is 3.8:1 — needs 4.5:1.
Ava: Agree re aria-live. For focus, let's move keyboard focus to the first failed item after scan. Also show a skip link to 'Detailed network results'.
Ravi: Ok for focus. Suggest we include compact `nc -vz <host> <port>` snippet customers can run internally in the details drawer. Is that okay copywise?
Jess: Small edit to banner: 'Network check found issues — your cluster may be unreachable. Learn how to resolve or re-run the check.' Shorter.
Maya: :thumbsup: that reads better. Also for the toggle, ensure it exposes aria-expanded and role="button".
Ava: One more UX nit: when tests fail due to DNS, show the failing FQDN and a suggested next step (e.g., 'Verify DNS records for <fqdn>'). Keep the message non-technical for PMs but expandable for ops.
Ravi: I'll wire the expandable details and include the `curl` example for http checks. Example: `curl -I http://<host>:<port>`
deploy-bot: Preflight run queued by @Ava. job_id=preflight-2026-03-23-42
Sam: Can we add a link to a short 90s video in the KB for the most common fixes? PMs love that.
Ava: Good call. @Jess can you draft a 3-line checklist for the KB? I'll update the mock and push to Figma later today.
Jess: Sure — I'll post a draft in #docs later. ETA 4pm.
Ava: Thanks everyone — will merge copy edits and send new mock by EOD :rocket:
